detail.longDescription: 🦟 NEW: Researchers tested how three South # Florida mosquito species, Aedes aegypti, Aedes albopictus, and Culex quinquefasciatus, responded to 119 human volunteers using a device that let # insects approach without biting. They matched each species to specific # skin odors and bacterial communities. Each # mosquito favored different # microbes , and no single person attracted all three species. 👉 https:// theconversation.com/mosquitoes -are-picky-eaters-we-studied-3-common-south-florida-species-to-learn-why-they-like-some-people-more-than-others-289647 # science # biology # microbiome # research # nature # animals # dengue # westnile # health # insects # study
